detail.longDescription: DB2 connection failed: com.ibm.db2.jcc.am.DisconnectNonTransientConnectionException: [jcc][t4][2043][11550][4.33.31] Exception java.net.ConnectException: Error opening socket to server URL on port 0000 with message: Connection refused. ERRORCODE=-4499, SQLSTATE=08001 I have a python application where a seperate thread that hits a table every 3 seconds looking for new entries. And the query runs for 10-30 secs. This application is continuously running app and uses a separate db2_conn using Jaydebeapi. Also the thread has to run in parallel with the main thread without lock or pause. For the JDBC URL, we are using the below parameters. We keep getting the above error every two weeks. There is no issue in the DB2 end or the rancher or the network. We are unable to narrow down the cause of this error. Parameters used: sslConnection=true;sslTrustStoreLocation={config.JKS_FILE_PATH}; currentPackageSet={config.CURRENT_PACKAGE_SET}; sslTrustStorePassword=; enableSysplexWLB=true; connectTimeout={config.DB2_CONNECT_TIMEOUT}; keepAlive=true;
